integrity: The correction is derived only from the source's displayed formulas, a positive rescaling, and an independent consistency check against the source's own saddle-node and homoclinic formulas; no independence beyond self-review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The finding corrects one sign in the source's local BT2 normal form. It does not independently recompute the full center-manifold reduction, the BT2 location, or all global numerical bifurcation diagrams. Arithmetic replay uses the rounded constants printed in the source.
title: A sign correction in the BT2 unfolding of an electromagnetic-induction neuron model
